title: Immersogeometric fluid-structure interaction modeling of the human mitral valve and transcatheter edge-to-edge repair
summary: Transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) treats mitral regurgitation with a clip that grasps and coapts the mitral valve (MV) leaflets. Predicting its outcome requires resolving the interaction between the blood flow and the complete MV apparatus, in which highly deformable leaflets and chordae tendineae undergo large deformation and complex contact.
